sections.heading: 1. Lower-rib breathing
lines: ① Rest your hands on your lower ribs.
② Breathe in, widening the ribs into your hands.
③ Breathe out and let shoulders drop.
④ 5 breaths, about 3 times a day.

slides.heading: Get assessed first if you notice

caption:
By mid-afternoon, Mr Turtle's shoulders are up near his ears. Neck and shoulder muscles often feel tight because they've been working hard for hours, not because they're short, so stretching relief can fade quickly.

Clinical Pilates takes a different angle: slower breathing into the lower ribs, upper-back strength so it shares the load with the neck, and gentle rotation to get a stiff mid-back moving.

Pins and needles or weakness in the arm, building headaches, dizziness or pain after a fall are worth assessing before you start. Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio builds programs around how you move. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
